verdict.rationale: Cursor offers pieces that could support a shared source of truth — Origin (a git forge for storing/sharing repos with your team, browsing/searching a shared codebase), project Rules to 'encode domain-specific knowledge about your codebase' and standardize architecture decisions, and integrations with GitHub/GitLab/Slack/Linear — but there is no documented unified 'workspace' feature that ingests docs plus repos into a single team-wide knowledge base/source of truth. Missing for 10: explicit documentation-ingestion/knowledge-base workspace UI, evidence of combining external docs with repo content in one shared artifact, and any hands-on confirmation this is used as a team 'source of truth.'
